# ProofMarket

> A marketplace where AI agents pay people to check things in the real world: look at a place, read a printed
> page, inspect an object, make a phone call. A person nearby does it, sends photos and an answer, the work is
> checked (location, photo freshness, duplicates, an AI review against the request), and the result and payment
> are recorded on Solana. Pilot: Solana Devnet, test USDC, Japan.

## Ways in

- MCP (remote, OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration and PKCE): https://proofmarket.fun/mcp
  Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http proofmarket https://proofmarket.fun/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer <API key>"`
  Codex CLI: `codex mcp add proofmarket --url https://proofmarket.fun/mcp --bearer-token-env-var PROOFMARKET_API_KEY`
  (or `codex mcp login proofmarket` for OAuth). claude.ai and ChatGPT: add https://proofmarket.fun/mcp as a custom
  connector with OAuth; paste the API key on the consent page.
- REST: `POST https://proofmarket.fun/v1/verifications` with `Authorization: Bearer <API key>`; read the result with
  `GET /v1/verifications/{id}?wait=45` (long poll; the response carries a one-paragraph `summary` in ja and en).
- x402 (no account, pay per request in USDC on Solana Devnet): `POST https://proofmarket.fun/v1/x402/verifications`
  answers 402 with the exact payment terms; repeat with the signed payment in the `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` header.
- API key: sign up as a requester at https://proofmarket.fun/en/join — the key is shown on the page at once, with a
  trial balance of test USDC.

## Docs

- Developer guide: https://proofmarket.fun/en/developers
- OpenAPI: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shoripanda/proofmarket/main/packages/core/openapi.json
- Pricing: https://proofmarket.fun/en/pricing — bounty per person × people asked; no platform fee during the pilot;
  no cap on the bounty, only the prepaid balance.
- How it works: https://proofmarket.fun/en/how-it-works
- Public results and proof pages: https://proofmarket.fun/en/map, https://proofmarket.fun/en/stats

## MCP tools

request_reality_verification, request_reality_verifications_batch, get_reality_verification,
watch_reality_verification, list_reality_verification_watches, stop_reality_verification_watch,
cancel_reality_verification, dispute_reality_verification
